anyhow.en: The revised manuscript reached the editors late, but the review continued anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 修订稿送达编辑部时已经迟了，但评审无论如何还是继续了。

anyhow.en: Funding decisions may change, and yet the fieldwork can proceed anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 经费的决定也许会变，但实地调查无论如何仍可进行。

anyhow.en: The committee rejected the draft, but the consultation will continue anyhow.
anyhow.zh: 委员会否决了草案，但征求意见无论如何还是要继续。

needless to say.en: Needless to say, the sample size was too small for reliable estimation.
needless to say.zh: 不用说，样本量太小，无法得到可靠的估计。

needless to say.en: Needless to say, the deadline moved forward before the report was finished.
needless to say.zh: 不用说，在报告完成之前截止日期就被提前了。

needless to say.en: Needless to say, the decline in enrollment surprised few of the observers.
needless to say.zh: 不用说，入学人数的下降很少让观察者感到意外。

it goes without saying.en: It goes without saying that the archive requires regular and careful maintenance.
it goes without saying.zh: 不言而喻，档案需要定期而细致的维护。

it goes without saying.en: It goes without saying that public funds must follow transparent reporting rules.
it goes without saying.zh: 不言而喻，公共资金必须遵循透明的报告规则。

it goes without saying.en: It goes without saying that the old bridge will eventually need replacement.
it goes without saying.zh: 不言而喻，那座旧桥最终需要更换。

to put it another way.en: To put it another way, the two measures capture related but distinct aspects.
to put it another way.zh: 换句话说，这两个指标捕捉的是相关却不同的方面。

to put it another way.en: To put it another way, the delay stems from staffing rather than from funding.
to put it another way.zh: 换句话说，延误源于人手而非资金。

to put it another way.en: To put it another way, the flood reshaped the river rather than merely widening it.
to put it another way.zh: 换句话说，那场洪水重塑了这条河，而不只是让它变宽。

put differently.en: The results, put differently, suggest that learning continues well beyond graduation.
put differently.zh: 换个说法，这些结果表明学习远在毕业之后仍在继续。

put differently.en: The mandate, put differently, asks agencies to disclose how they rank applicants.
put differently.zh: 换个说法，这项指令要求各机构公开其对申请人的排序方式。

put differently.en: The story, put differently, describes a family adjusting to a smaller farm.
put differently.zh: 换个说法，这个故事讲述的是一个家庭适应更小的农场。

in simple terms.en: The revised index, in simple terms, measures how quickly a paper is cited.
in simple terms.zh: 简单地说，修订后的指数衡量的是一篇论文被引用的速度。

in simple terms.en: The instruction, in simple terms, tells each reviewer to summarize the main argument.
in simple terms.zh: 用简单的话说，这份说明要求每位评审概括主要论点。

in simple terms.en: The migration, in simple terms, moved thousands of households closer to the river.
in simple terms.zh: 简单地说，这场迁移让成千上万户人家搬到离河更近的地方。

as follows.en: The main findings of the survey are as follows.
The committee's decisions on the three applications are as follows.
as follows.zh: 委员会对这三份申请的决定如下。

as follows.en: The recorded reasons for withdrawing from the program are as follows.
as follows.zh: 记录在案的退出该项目的理由如下。

first and foremost.en: First and foremost, the study examines how readers process dense technical prose.
first and foremost.zh: 首要的是，本研究考察读者如何处理密集的技术性文本。

first and foremost.en: First and foremost, the agency must protect the independence of its review panels.
first and foremost.zh: 首要的是，该机构必须保护其评审小组的独立性。

first and foremost.en: First and foremost, the shortage of housing shaped the family's decision to move.
first and foremost.zh: 首要的是，住房短缺塑造了这个家庭搬迁的决定。

last but not least.en: Last but not least, the survey collected no identifying information about its participants.
last but not least.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，这项调查没有收集参与者的身份信息。

last but not least.en: Last but not least, the team reserved Friday afternoon for peer feedback.
last but not least.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，团队预留了周五下午用于同行反馈。

last but not least.en: Last but not least, the harbor's quiet mornings attract more than its sunsets do.
last but not least.zh: 最后但同样重要的是，这座海港吸引人的与其说是日落，不如说是清晨的宁静。

at the same time.en: The model explains the trend well, at the same time hiding the variation between regions.
at the same time.zh: 该模型很好地解释了趋势，却同时掩盖了地区之间的差异。

at the same time.en: The reform improves access, at the same time weakening the safeguards that protect minority languages.
at the same time.zh: 这项改革改善了可及性，却同时削弱了保护少数族群语言的保障措施。

at the same time.en: The river narrowed, at the same time deepening the mudflats along its banks.
at the same time.zh: 河道变窄了，却同时使沿岸的滩涂更深。

for that matter.en: The museum attracts more visitors now, and for that matter its collection has grown.
for that matter.zh: 博物馆如今吸引的访客更多，就这一点而言，其藏品也有增加。

for that matter.en: The council consulted residents, and for that matter it published the raw responses.
for that matter.zh: 委员会征求了居民意见，就这一点而言，它还公开了原始答复。

for that matter.en: The factory closed last spring; for that matter, the whole industrial district looks quiet.
for that matter.zh: 那家工厂去年春天关闭了；就这一点而言，整个工业区看上去都很冷清。

on that note.en: On that note, we turn to the methodological limits of the design.
on that note.zh: 说到这里，我们转而讨论这一研究设计的方法论局限。

on that note.en: On that note, please send the revised budget to the finance team.
on that note.zh: 说到这里，请把修订后的预算发给财务团队。

on that note.en: On that note, the river has never run clearer than in the dry season.
on that note.zh: 说到这里，这条河从未比旱季时更清澈。
